decisions.no_gpt4o: Do not use GPT-4o or GPT-4o-mini for any role.

judge.comparability: GPT-5-family judge/self-consistency score; not published LongMemEval comparable.
judge.calibration_cross_check: Also score 3-case calibration with gpt-5.4-mini-memory and flag judge disagreements.

decisions.case_isolation: Fresh synthetic user ID per case where possible; terminal cleanup after scoring.
decisions.concurrency: Serial through 10-case pilot; controlled parallelism only after 50-case tier proves separate-user isolation.
decisions.cost: No cap; still estimate and record cost/tokens.
decisions.environment: Dev environment acceptable for calibration/pilot with public-network caveat.

dlq_baseline.comparison: compare message IDs against dlq_baseline_messages.json; halt on any new message ID
